about: every contest whose office type, p or presence changed in the three fixes from M2's check of #73 (check c24; the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 13:54: 'Put it back in data/state-lower/2018/VA.json, as a special, with its old fields. No contest should drop out of the record.' and 'A superintendent is one executive seat, not a board. Type them as officers and list the moves.'). A school superintendent's office (SUPERINTENDENT, SUPT or SUPER. OF PUBLIC INSTRUCTION, with SCHOOL, EDUCATION or INSTRUCTION in the office's words) is typed 'clerk, treasurer or other county officer', not 'school board' (pipeline/local_medsl.py, OFFICE_TYPES); a water superintendent stays a special district. 'T': the type corrected, p unchanged; 'T+P': the type corrected and p moved; 'P': p moved, the type unchanged, the like races of its class or of the fit's pool changed; 'C': p unchanged and the type unchanged, only the p block's not-of-record factor moved (calibration_not_of_record, 0.7951 to 0.791), recoded from 'P' at 2026-11-07 15:56 UTC after M2's check c29 §29.1 found that 854 of the 1,720 rows first coded 'P' have p before equal to p after; 'R': p not computed before or after, the count of like races its reason gives changed; 'added': back in the record. Columns: id, office, type before, type after, p before, p after, code. No p became computed or uncomputed. data/local/REPORT.md section 15. Written by worker D3 at 2026-11-07 14:15 UTC.
